description: This file defines the IMigration interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including enums for BootType and MigrationStatus, associated data structures, and virtual methods for retrieving and setting migration-related information.

classes.name: IMigration
classes.description: Interface for migration operations, including retrieving boot type info, migration status, and setting migration status.

methods.name: SetMigrationStatus

methods.name: GetMigrationStatus
